ranged_attack.name: Thorn Bolt
ranged_attack.windup: plants his feet and levels his spiral staff at {target} with both hands, green light and swirling leaves gathering into a glowing thorn at its tip
ranged_attack.release: thrusts the staff forward and a blazing emerald-green thorn bolt shoots from its tip
ranged_attack.travel: the glowing thorn bolt spins across the courtyard as a bright green streak shedding tiny luminous leaves
ranged_attack.impact: it bursts against {target} in a sharp green-gold flash and a spray of glowing thorns and leaves
ranged_attack.decay: the green light and leaves vanish in a split second, leaving {target} clear
ranged_attack.again: levels his staff again and launches another glowing green thorn bolt that bursts in a bright flash against {target} and vanishes at once
ranged_attack.text: levels his spiral staff at {target}, green light swirling at its tip, and launches a glowing thorn bolt that bursts in a bright green flash on it and vanishes at once

melee_attack.name: Thorn Staff
melee_attack.windup: steps in and pulls his spiral staff back with both hands, glowing green thorny vines curling around its head
melee_attack.impact: the thorn-wrapped head jabs into {target} in a bright green flash and a spray of glowing leaves
melee_attack.decay: the green glow fades at once
melee_attack.recover: brings the staff back upright beside him
melee_attack.again: jabs his thorny staff into {target} again in a bright green flash that fades at once
melee_attack.text: pulls his spiral staff back and thrusts its thorn-wrapped head into {target} in a bright green flash of leaves that fades at once

dash.name: Leaf Dash
dash.text: dashes forward in a swirl of glowing green leaves
